title: State-contract program: inspected source changes
summary: Exact blob bindings identify inspected source bytes; the linked revision is the committed source base. Implementation, verification, live host qualification and release remain separate claims. Real user stops and host permissions remain effective. This source review covers progress preservation, discovery capture, bounded recovery, scoped conflicts, generator and manifest contracts; it is not installed-host certification.

changes.summary: Compatibility routes keep their identities; removal requires the declared major-version floors, fresh confirmed publication evidence and a separately approved named removal.
Conflicting rules pause affected work and actual authority, data or decision dependents. Independent authorized work continues; global user and host stops remain global.
